description.value: Mr Sushi Canada is a family-owned sushi restaurant established in North Vancouver in the early 1990s, with this third location opening in Vancouver's Mount Pleasant/Olympic Village neighbourhood in 2023. The restaurant emphasises carefully sourced, fresh ingredients and has earned a North Shore News Readers' Choice Award. Cyclists can eat in or order for pickup or third-party delivery.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack (42 spaces, covered) at 86m; rack (20 spaces, covered) at 94m. Total: 62 spaces.

Takeout is confirmed by prominent 'ORDER FOR PICKUP' and 'Eat-in, Take-Out or Delivery' copy throughout the site. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, etc.) are mentioned anywhere in the website content, so those remain null.
